purpose: Truthful logical-vs-upstream cancellation semantics for P020 readiness
invariants: logical cancel intent is durable before any upstream cancel call
logical cancel never implies upstream compute stopped unless provider evidence confirms it
repeated cancel does not repeat a provider cancel call without proven idempotency
cancelled output disposition is discard and ready-vs-cancel cannot resurrect results
existing client snapshot remains canonical phase=cancelled while extra cancellation truth is evidence-only metadata

scenarios.case: provider cancel accepted but not confirmed

scenarios.expect: logical cancelled_unbound; no fake upstream cancellation

scenarios.case: provider becomes ready after logical cancel

scenarios.expect: phase remains cancelled; provider failure retained as evidence

scenarios.case: provider claimed confirmed then still separates

scenarios.expect: durable cancel registry blocks output delivery
